# Anchor 1.15.1 file readers (test only)

Copied unchanged from tag `anchor-1.15.1` (src/format and the domain files they import), so the
tests can check that a file written by this version and saved again by 1.15.1 keeps every new key.
Not part of the app. Jest finds tests only in `tests/**/*.test.ts`, so nothing here runs on its own.
